questions: How do I mount a host path into execution environments in controller?
How do I stop Jinja in extra vars in automation controller?
How do I set a proxy for ansible-galaxy in project updates?
Which modules can ad hoc commands use?

answer_card.title: Expose a host directory to jobs
answer_card.answer_md: In **Settings > Automation Execution > Job**, add the path to **Paths to expose to isolated jobs**, one per line, in the format `HOST-DIR[:CONTAINER-DIR[:OPTIONS]]`, for example `/opt/certs:/opt/certs:O`. If you give a file, its whole directory is mounted. Volumes are mounted from the execution node into the container.
